case_name: Concurrency: Goroutine Leak on Context Cancellation

subject_result.rationale: The review perfectly identifies the exact goroutine leak issue outlined in the rubric with high technical precision. It clearly explains the failure mode (blocking send on an unbuffered channel when ctx.Done() selects first), details the operational impact (memory and goroutine exhaustion), and provides both recommended solutions from the rubric: using a buffered channel (`make(chan fetchResult, 1)`) and propagating the context directly to the backend interface.
findings: Accurately identified the goroutine leak caused by the unbuffered channel.
Correctly recommended buffering the channel with a capacity of 1.
Suggested context propagation to the underlying backend call as an architectural improvement.
Included an additional insightful observation about checking context cancellation prior to spawning goroutines.
